room.title: Room
room.description: Pick the AC, its power sensor, and the room and outdoor temperature sensors. Every other setting is optional.

comfort.title: Comfort and presets
comfort.description: Setpoints for the comfort, eco, boost and away presets, the schedule, vacation and the away delay. Submit empty to keep the defaults.

data.heat_eco_c: Heat setpoint under eco and when motion is idle (°C, optional). Unset heats to comfort minus 1.
data.heat_boost_c: Heat setpoint under boost (°C, optional). Unset heats to comfort plus 1.
data.comfort_energy_weight: Comfort to eco weight, 0 to 1 (optional, 0 is off)
data.schedule_blocks: Schedule blocks: a list of [start_h, end_h, preset], hours 0 to 24, preset comfort, eco, boost or away (optional)
data.vacation: Vacation switch, on means vacation mode (optional)
data.away_delay_min: Minutes without presence before away mode

price.title: Price
price.description: The electricity price sensor, the cheap and expensive thresholds and an energy counter. Submit empty to skip.

heater.title: Heater
heater.description: A heater switch or valve, its PID or TPI settings and output limits. Submit empty to skip.

data.heater_inverted: Heater switch is inverted (on means off)
data.radiators: Heater is radiators or underfloor heat (residual heat after it stops)
data.tpi_coef_int: TPI coefficient for the room gap (per K, used with TPI)
data.tpi_coef_ext: TPI coefficient for the outdoor gap (per K, used with TPI)
data.tpi_threshold_high: TPI high threshold, K above target while the room rises (TPI; 0 is off, needs the low threshold)
data.tpi_threshold_low: TPI low threshold, K above target while the room falls (TPI; 0 is off, needs the high threshold)
data.max_on_percent: TPI maximum on-percent (TPI; unset means no cap)
data.output_min_entity: Minimum heater output number entity (optional, overrides the minimum above)
data.output_max_entity: Maximum heater output number entity (optional, overrides the maximum above)
data.trv_temperature: TRV own temperature sensor (optional, needs a valve). A TRV that reads warmer than the room opens the valve more. Each 1 K of offset (TRV minus room) moves the valve opening by 100 percentage points, clamped to 0 to 100.
data.ac_heat: Let the AC heat when the heat source is the AC (no heater switch)
data.mpc_heat_plan: Heat plan starts AC heat when its first step says heat (AC heat source, no heater switch, someone home)

occupancy.title: Occupancy and windows
occupancy.description: Presence, motion, window and cover sensors, window size and direction, solar irradiance and the weather forecast. Submit empty to skip.

data.presence: Presence sources: any home means home, all away for the away delay means away (optional)
data.motion_away_min: Minutes without motion before the room counts as unoccupied
data.window_delay_min: Minutes a window may stay open before the AC pauses
data.window_actuator: Window actuator, a cover or switch (optional): opens on natural ventilation or economizer advice
data.window_azimuth: Window facing direction, degrees from north (optional)
data.window_area_m2: Window area, m² (optional, needed for solar gain)
data.irradiance: Irradiance sensor on the window, W/m² (optional)
data.heatwave_warning: Heatwave warning binary sensor, on means a warning is current (optional)

air_quality.title: Air quality and humidity
air_quality.description: Humidity, CO2 and PM2.5 sensors and the fan, dehumidifier, humidifier and ventilation switches. Submit empty to skip.

data.room_humidity: Room humidity sensor, e.g. the bedroom monitor (optional)
data.auto_fan: Set the AC fan mode from the room gap while cooling
data.coil_dry: Dry the AC coil after cooling
data.dry_for_humidity: Use the AC dry mode when humid (no dehumidifier set; uses a lot of water)
data.house_sealed: House is sealed (never run the whole-house fan)
data.economizer_fan: Economizer fan assist: run the fan switch in the economizer fan_assist phase (home, unlocked, no stalled sensor)

devices.title: Devices and power limits
devices.description: A second AC, a list of room devices, whole-house power and load shedding, and the restart delay. Submit empty to skip.

data.climate_2: Second AC in the same room (optional)
data.power_2: Second AC power sensor, W (optional, enables the two-device fit)
data.fleet: Room devices: a list of [device_id, kind cool or heat, rate_k_per_h_per_kw, rated_w, power_sensor optional]
data.dispatch_mode: Device choice: fast (highest effect first) or economy (lowest cost per kelvin)
data.shed_loads: Loads to shed, as entity_id|watts, lowest priority first (optional)
data.compressor_group: Compressor group name (optional). Entries with the same name keep at least 5 minutes between their AC starts.
data.min_on_min: Minimum AC on time (min), deprecated: a stop is never delayed and this value is ignored
data.min_off_min: Restart delay (min): wait this long after a device stops before it starts again (0 disables the delay)

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.description: The control switch (off means observe only), the lock PIN, the stall window, the AI investigator and the peer room settings. Submit empty to skip.

data.control: Let HVAC Horizon control the AC (off = observe only)
data.stall_window_s: Seconds without a report before a sensor counts as stalled (default 900)
data.night_plan_act: Night plan acts on the AC: pre-cool cools to comfort, hold stops a cool start
data.accuracy_panel: Show this entry in the HVAC Accuracy sidebar panel (one panel for all entries)
data.peer_entry: Peer entry, the entry_id or title of another HVAC Horizon entry (optional): its valve opens when this room is 2 K warmer
data.peer_setpoint_mode: Peer setpoint mode: with a peer entry, a room 2 K warmer lowers the peer cool setpoint by 1 K instead of opening its valve
data.setpoint_regulation: Setpoint regulation: move the AC setpoint by the gap between the room median and the AC's own temperature reading (default on)
data.ai_conversation: AI conversation agent for the investigator (optional)
data.ai_budget_per_day: Model calls per day for the investigator (0 or empty is off)

menu.title: What next
menu.description: The room is set up. Finish now to start in observe-only mode, or open a section to add more. Each section can be left empty.

menu_options.finish: Finish now (observe only unless you turned control on)

reconfigure.title: Edit HVAC Horizon
reconfigure.description: Open a section to change it, then choose Save and close. Stored samples are kept. A field you clear in a section is removed.

abort.already_configured: This AC is already set up.
abort.reconfigure_successful: Settings updated. Stored samples are kept.

error.invalid_price: Enter a price as a number from 0 to 10.
error.price_order: The cheap price threshold must be below the expensive price threshold.
error.invalid_schedule_blocks: Schedule blocks must be a list of [start_h, end_h, preset]. Hours run from 0 to 24 and start_h must differ from end_h. Presets: comfort, eco, boost, away.

start_autotune.name: Start auto-tune
start_autotune.description: Start a relay test at a setpoint. It switches the heater plug on and off, obeys the heat-on threshold and the AC cooling cutoff, and ends after 120 minutes. The setpoint must be at least 2 K above the room.

entry_id.name: Entry
entry_id.description: The HVAC Horizon entry to tune.

cancel_autotune.name: Cancel auto-tune
cancel_autotune.description: End a running relay test and turn the heater off.

entry_id.name: Entry
entry_id.description: The HVAC Horizon entry whose test to cancel.

set_lock.name: Set lock
set_lock.description: Lock control so no commands are sent, or unlock it. Unlocking needs the configured PIN.

set_house_mode.name: Set house mode
set_house_mode.description: Set home or away for every HVAC Horizon room. Away makes each room use its away setpoint.

export_csv.name: Export CSV
export_csv.description: Return the stored readings as CSV text, in the layout the backfill tool reads.

reset_learning.name: Reset learning
reset_learning.description: Forget the stored samples and the fitted model for an HVAC Horizon entry.

entry_id.name: Entry
entry_id.description: The HVAC Horizon entry to reset.

export_samples.name: Export samples
export_samples.description: Return the stored readings for an HVAC Horizon entry.

what_if.name: What-if forecast
what_if.description: Forecast minutes, energy and cost to a target for given conditions, using the current model and price slots.

start_timed_preset.name: Start timed preset
start_timed_preset.description: Use a preset's setpoint for a set number of minutes, then return to the normal preset.

respond_suggestion.name: Respond to learning suggestion
respond_suggestion.description: Accept the learned heat gain as the new baseline, or dismiss the current suggestion until the gain changes again.

generate_investigation_report.name: Generate investigation report
generate_investigation_report.description: Build a report on the AC from the last 24 hours of readings. Uses the conversation agent when one is set and the daily model budget allows; otherwise stores the rule-based report.

sensors_stalled.title: HVAC Horizon sensors not updating
sensors_stalled.description: These sensors have not updated recently: {sensors}. The AC and heater stop while the outdoor sensor is stale or no room sensor is fresh.

heating_failure.title: HVAC Horizon heater is not warming the room
heating_failure.description: The heater has been on for 60 minutes and the room has risen less than 0.5 °C. Check the heater and its switch.

mode_mismatch.title: HVAC Horizon mode does not match
mode_mismatch.description: The AC is in a different mode than HVAC Horizon last set. Check whether it was changed on the unit or another automation.
